title: NIRIKSHAK remediation snippet
description: One vetted remediation for one rule on one platform. CLAUDE.md Rule 4 - commands are read from this library and never generated. A snippet without a human vetter and a cited vendor document is not a snippet.

rule_id.description: The rule this remediates, e.g. NRK-TELNET-001.

os_version_range.description: e.g. '>=15.0 <18.0'. Null means the vetter did not bound it.

commands.description: Exactly what the operator types. Never generated, never inferred.

depends_on.description: snippet_ids that must be applied first.

vetted_by.description: The person who checked these commands against the cited document. Rule 4 - never a model, never a placeholder.

reference.description: The vendor document the commands were checked against. Required by docs/CONTENT_POLICY.md: an identifier and a locator, never transcribed vendor prose.
